name: vite-project
description: A web-based quiz application that allows users to register, login, create quizzes, take quizzes, and view results. The app supports both multiple-choice and open-ended questions, with automatic grading for multiple-choice questions and manual grading for open-ended questions. ## Technologies Used: - **Node.js**: Backend runtime environment for JavaScript. - **Express.js**: Framework for building the server-side of the app. - **MongoDB**: NoSQL database for storing user data, quizzes, and results. - **React**: Frontend framework for building the user interface. ## Features
